summary: Ridgetech Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting termination of an at-the-market (ATM) offering sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC. No specific deal terms, premium, or price per share were disclosed. The filing is a routine contractual update with no extraordinary corporate event. The termination of an ATM facility does not constitute a special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or going-private transaction. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing lacks structural or event-driven catalysts for a risk-arb strategy. Accordingly, this is not classified as a special situation.
